notes.iv: Implied vol in Paracord convention (Black-Scholes, r=0, no dividends). "chain": backed out of listed Nov-20-2026 put mids (higher of ATM and 5%-OTM). "iv30": CBOE 30-day IV x 1.040 (median chain/iv30 ratio on the chain names; covers skew + convention) -- ESTIMATE. "proxy": no options data, 1.25 x realized -- ESTIMATE. "assumed": fictional.
notes.iv_base: Implied vol with the earnings event removed when a known earnings date falls inside the quote window.
notes.earn_move: Assumed 1-day earnings move = 2 x normal daily move (ESTIMATE). Added back only when the earnings date falls inside a lock window.
notes.earn: Only names in tools/earnings_dates.csv (hand-checked, sourced) have dates; others unknown (null).
notes.shares_out: SEC dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding; est = filled from median turnover (0.0083/day). Used as float proxy.
notes.liq: Options liquidity tier: A = 1-month 5%%-OTM put spread <= 10%% and weekly expiries; B <= 20%%; C wider; none = no usable chain.
notes.a_c: Factor loadings (correlation units) from 501 sessions: a = equal-weight market, c = own-sector (ex-market).
notes.rounding: Prices 2 dp, vols 4 dp, share/volume counts 3 significant figures.
